<mxfile host="drawio" version="24.7.17"> <diagram id="drift-decision" name="Drift decision"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="900" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1000" pageHeight="1800" background="#FFFFFF" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" value="Drift detection: how a column is judged drifted" style="text;html=0;fontSize=20;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#1A1A19;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="0" width="620" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ref" value="Reference data
rows loaded when the model was trained
(raw snapshot, before preprocessing and split)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="50" width="320" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cur" value="Current data
uploaded CSV or Parquet
in the same raw format" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="400" y="50" width="240" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="prep" value="Backend: drop the target and explicitly dropped columns on both sides" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="170" width="600" height="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="core" value="skyulf-core: DriftCalculator.calculate_drift" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=2;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="250" width="940" height="1234" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="q_common" value="Column in both
datasets?" style="rhombus;html=0;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="240" y="300" width="200" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="schema" value="Schema drift
missing_columns, new_columns" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FDECEC;strokeColor=#B85450;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="680" y="315" width="250" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="q_values" value="Non-null values
on both sides?" style="rhombus;html=0;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="240" y="450" width="200" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="unscored" value="Not scored
(no column_drifts entry)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#F5F5F5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="680" y="465" width="250" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="q_type" value="Current type
compatible?" style="rhombus;html=0;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="240" y="600" width="200" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="typedrift" value="type_drift: drifted, no evidence test
e.g. text that is not numeric,
or Date compared with Datetime" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FDECEC;strokeColor=#B85450;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="680" y="605" width="250" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="numeric" value="Numeric, Date, Datetime
wasserstein_distance / reference std
ks_statistic (two-sample KS)
psi (up to 10 reference bins)
kl_divergence (same bins)
ks_test_p_value: evidence only" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=6;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="750" width="290" height="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="categorical" value="String, Categorical, Enum, Boolean
psi_categorical (category shares)
over 50 reference categories:
top 50 plus one pooled tail,
new_category_rate (diagnostic only);
ID-like columns (over 50% unique) skipped" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=6;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="350" y="750" width="290" height="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="effect" value="Effect: any metric value > its threshold
defaults psi 0.2, ks_statistic 0.1, wasserstein 0.1, kl_divergence 0.1
(psi_categorical uses psi; thresholds can be overridden per check)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="950" width="600" height="64" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="evidence" value="Statistical evidence, after every column is measured
numeric: KS p-value; categorical: Fisher exact (2 categories),
chi-square (observed and expected cells at least 5) or per-category Fisher
Bonferroni across the tested columns, significance level 0.05
status: supported, not_detected, insufficient_data, unavailable" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=6;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="1064" width="600" height="104" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="q_verdict" value="Effect AND
evidence
supported?" style="rhombus;html=0;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="230" y="1234" width="220" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="drifted" value="Drifted
drift_detected = true" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FDECEC;strokeColor=#B85450;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="680" y="1259" width="250" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="notdrifted" value="Not drifted
evidence reason, if any, is the suggestion" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="190" y="1404" width="300" height="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="report" value="DriftReport
drifted_columns_count = drifted columns + missing columns + new columns
per-column metrics, evidence and suggestions" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#F3E8FF;strokeColor=#9673A6;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="1534" width="900" height="64" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="alert" value="Backend alert history: one DriftCheckResult row per check

g.text: Statistical evidence, after every column is measured
numeric: KS p-value; categorical: Fisher exact (2 categories),
chi-square (observed and expected cells at least 5) or per-category Fisher
Bonferroni across the tested columns, significance level 0.05

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(253, 236, 236), rgb(42, 28, 28)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

g.text: evidence reason, if any, is the suggestion
drifted_columns_count = drifted columns + missing columns + new columns

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 244, 229), rgb(34, 25, 12)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

g.text: Backend alert history: one DriftCheckResult row per check
evaluation_status completed, no_baseline or failed; completed checks pin the threshold set to a version
severity: critical (schema drift, or over 30% of scored columns drifted), warning (any drifted), else none
status: new, acknowledged, resolved; reopen from acknowledged or resolved
